styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Puppet-state palace, film museum and wartime sites.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Park lakes, forests and winter ice on the rivers.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Northeast barbecue, dumplings and street snacks.

stays.why: Central and walkable; metro lines 1 and 2 meet here, so most sights are a short ride away.
Shopping and food street; busy at night, easy taxis, good budget-to-mid choice.
Student and Korean-food district; cheapest eats and a lively evening scene.
Quieter, greener area near the car industry district; handy if you have business there.

food: Try Northeast barbecue (chuan'r) and guo bao rou, sweet-and-sour pork slices. Portions are big; share.
Dumplings and cold noodles are cheap and filling; a meal often costs ¥20–40.
Guilin Road has Korean and student food: stews, fried chicken, late-night snacks.
Winter markets sell frozen pears and tanghulu; eat them outside, they are meant to be cold.
Look for hot pot and iron-pot stews in winter. Book ahead on weekend evenings.
more_time: Add a half-day at Jingyuetan park: lake walks, forest trails and winter skiing; check opening hours on the day.
History fans can swap a shopping afternoon for the Film Museum and the old puppet-state buildings; check tickets on the day.
In winter, swap a park visit for an indoor museum or the hot springs outside town; check transport on the day.

recommend.why: Two nights cover the wartime history, the film museum and a food evening; add a night for Jingyuetan or a winter day trip.

month_notes: January: very cold, highs near -8°C. Dress in layers and plan indoor sights.
February: still freezing, around -3°C by day. Short days; check opening hours.
March: warming to 7°C but windy and dusty. A coat still needed.
April: mild at 15°C, good for walking. A few rain days.
May: pleasant at 22°C, the best month to be outside.
June: warm at 26°C with frequent rain. Carry an umbrella.
July: hottest and wettest, highs near 28°C. Go out early.
August: hot and rainy, similar to July. Indoor sights are a good bet.
September: cooler at 22°C and drier. A great month to visit.
October: crisp at 13°C, good light. Bring a jacket.
November: cold at 2°C, short days. Fewer crowds.
December: freezing at -7°C. Pack boots and a warm hat.

climate_guide.summary: Cold continental climate: long freezing winters, short warm summers, and most rain from June to August.

items.title: Winter is long and harsh
items.text: December to February highs sit near -8 to -3°C, lows to -18°C. Pack boots, a hat and layers.

items.title: Best time: May and September
items.text: Around 22°C by day, mild evenings and fewer rain days. Ideal for parks and walking.

items.title: Rain peaks in summer
items.text: June to August bring 14–15 rain days a month. Carry an umbrella and plan indoor backups.

items.title: Short, warm summer
items.text: July highs near 28°C with humid nights around 20°C. Go out early or after sunset.

items.title: Spring and autumn are short
items.text: April and October are mild but changeable; March and November can still feel like winter.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Warm layers and boots for November to March; light clothes and rain gear for June to August.

transit.best: Metro for most trips; taxis are cheap for short hops.

modes.text: 6 lines (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8) cover many central areas. A T-Union card works.
Trams 54 and 55 run in the west; fare ¥2. Route 55 ends at West station.
Extensive and about ¥2. Chinese reading helps a lot.
Cheap and easy: flag fall ¥5 plus ¥1 fuel surcharge. Didi works; local apps may need Chinese registration.
Not needed for a city visit; traffic and parking are a hassle.
Fine May to mid-November. Cycling is risky in traffic.
